scientific_interpretation: EXP-MC1 generalization error is strongly time-dependent: the largest pooled RMSE occurs at 60 days and errors decline substantially at late times.
The low-saturation region has the largest regional RMSE, while the high-saturation region is substantially easier.
The worst point is an overprediction in a low-saturation cell-like streamline location at 365 days, consistent with localized front/tail-position error rather than uniform saturation bias.
The front region contains most evaluated values and contributes meaningful error, but its pooled RMSE is lower than the low-saturation region.
These are post-OOD descriptive findings and must not be used to retune or reselect EXP-MC1.

decision.reason: The principal V16D objective is broader Foundation-Case generalization. MC1 already establishes useful geology-OOD performance; varying controls now tests a new axis of generalization rather than optimizing against the observed OOD set.
decision.geology_recipe: keep Recipe1.1 spectral GRF frozen for the first control-space study
decision.MC2_future_role: new independently designed experiment after control-space dataset design; D20 findings may motivate hypotheses but not retroactive MC1 tuning
